version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This Airtable skill is coherent, but it asks users to trust an unpinned external plugin that handles OAuth-backed Airtable access and can change or delete data.

dimensions.detail: The plugin is purpose-aligned, but the resulting Airtable authority can cover all bases and tables accessible to the connected account, including schema and destructive record/comment actions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install instructions fetch clawhub:clawlink-plugin without a pinned version or digest, then add it to the OpenClaw tool allowlist and restart the gateway.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses read and write workflows, tells the agent to preview writes, and requires explicit confirmation for create, update, and delete actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill makes a persistent OpenClaw configuration change by allowlisting the plugin, and ClawLink stores and injects the user's Airtable OAuth token for future calls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the capabilities: browsing Airtable bases, schemas, records, comments, attachments, and performing create, update, and delete operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the ClawLink plugin and its requested Airtable scopes before installing. Use an Airtable account with the narrowest practical access, confirm every write or delete carefully, and know how to remove the plugin and revoke Airtable OAuth access if you stop using it.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: Installing ClawLink is expected for this integration, but the artifact does not pin or bundle the reviewed plugin while granting it OAuth-backed Airtable read/write/delete capability.
